en.sayed-ali-raza: a time will come to you when Islam would be capsized as a pot is capsized with all its contents.
O people, Allāh has protected you from that He might be hard on you but He has not spared you from being put on trial.
Allāh the Most Sublime of all speakers has said : Verily in this are signs and We do only try (the people). (Qur’ān, 23:30)
